title: Model redirection
description: Send the model an agent asks for under another name. Replies name the model that was asked for.
keep.label: Keep the upstream model's name in replies
keep.hint: Off: a reply says the model the agent asked for, so an agent that reads its model back (Claude Code, for its context window) sees what it asked for.
rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Exact names are tried first, then patterns in order. Names chain (a → b → c) until nothing more maps; a cycle stops before it repeats.
from.label: Asked model
from.hint: A name, or a regular expression written /like this/ (flags allowed: /^gpt-4o/i).
to.label: Sent as
to.hint: A model of one of your providers. For a pattern, $1 is its first group.
kind.label: Kind
error.from.empty: Enter the model name or pattern
error.from.regex: This is not a valid regular expression
error.from.duplicate: A rule for this name already exists
